# Game Idea: Space Escape

- Control a spaceship navigating an endless field of moving asteroids.
- Use arrow keys (or WASD) to steer; spacebar for a temporary boost.
- Collect fuel cells for points and to extend play time.
- **Lose condition:** Collide with an asteroid **or** run out of fuel.
- Simple graphics with circles and lines drawn on an HTML canvas.

1: // Simple Space Escape game with enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
9:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600);
10: 
11:   // background stars
12:   const stars = [];
13:   function spawnStars(count = 100) {
14:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
15:       stars.push({
16:         x: Math.random() * W,
17:         y: Math.random() * H,
18:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
19:       });
20:     }
21:   }
22:   spawnStars();
23: 
24:   // Ship definition
25:   // Audio setup
26:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
27:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
28:   let audioUnlocked = false;
29:   function unlockAudio() {
30:     if (audioUnlocked) return;
31:     audioCtx.resume();
32:     audioUnlocked = true;
33:   }
34:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
35:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
36:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
37:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
38:     osc.type = 'sine';
39:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
40:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
41:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
42:     osc.start();
43:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
44:   }
45:   function playBoost() { playTone(660, 120); }
46:   function playCollect() { playTone(880, 100); }
47:   function playExplosion() { playTone(200, 400); }
48:   function playThrustStart() { playTone(300, 200); }
49: 
50:   const ship = {
51:   const ship = {
52:     x: W / 2,
53:     y: H / 2,
54:     r: 12,
55:     angle: 0,
56:     speed: 0,
57:     fuel: 100,
58:     boostTime: 0,
59:   };
60: 
61:   const keys = {};
62:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
63:   unlockAudio();
64:   const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
65:   keys[k] = true;
66:   if (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'w') playThrustStart();
67: });
68:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false));
69: 
70:   const asteroids = [];
71:   const fuels = [];
72: 
73:   function spawnAsteroid() {
74:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
75:     asteroids.push({
76:       x: W + size,
77:       y: Math.random() * H,
78:       r: size,
79:       vx: - (1 + Math.random() * 2),
80:     });
81:   }
82: 
83:   function spawnFuel() {
84:     const r = 8;
85:     fuels.push({
86:       x: W + r,
87:       y: Math.random() * H,
88:       r,
89:       vx: -1.5,
90:     });
91:   }
92: 
93:   // Initial spawns
94:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnAsteroid();
95:   for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) spawnFuel();
96: 
97:   function update(dt) {
98:     // Controls
99:     const turnSpeed = 0.003 * dt;
100:     if (keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a']) ship.angle -= turnSpeed;
101:     if (keys['arrowright'] || keys['d']) ship.angle += turnSpeed;
102:     if (keys['arrowup'] || keys['w']) ship.speed = 0.1 * dt;
103:     if (keys['arrowdown'] || keys['s']) ship.speed = -0.05 * dt;
104:     if (keys[' ']) {
105:       ship.boostTime = 200; // ms boost
106:       playBoost();
107:     }
108:     if (ship.boostTime > 0) {
109:       ship.speed += 0.2 * dt;
110:       ship.boostTime -= dt;
111:     }
112:     // Apply movement
113:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
114:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
115:     // Keep inside bounds
116:     ship.x = (ship.x + W) % W;
117:     ship.y = (ship.y + H) % H;
118:     // Fuel consumption
119:     ship.fuel -= 0.02 * dt / 1000;
120:     // Update asteroids
121:     asteroids.forEach(a => (a.x += a.vx * dt * 0.001));
122:     // Update fuels
123:     fuels.forEach(f => (f.x += f.vx * dt * 0.001));
124:     // Remove off‑screen objects
125:     asteroids.filter(a => a.x + a.r > 0);
126:     fuels.filter(f => f.x + f.r > 0);
127:     // Spawn new obstacles/fuel periodically
128:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) spawnAsteroid();
129:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnFuel();
130:     // Collision detection
131:     for (const a of asteroids) {
132:       const dx = a.x - ship.x, dy = a.y - ship.y;
133:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (a.r + ship.r) ** 2) {
134:         gameOver();
135:         return;
136:       }
137:     }
138:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
139:       const f = fuels[i];
140:       const dx = f.x - ship.x, dy = f.y - ship.y;
141:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (f.r + ship.r) ** 2) {
142:         ship.fuel = Math.min(ship.fuel + 30, 100);
143:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
144:         playCollect();
145:       }
146:     }
147:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) {
148:       gameOver();
149:     }
150:   }
151: 
152:   function draw() {
153:     // Clear background
154:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
155:     // Draw star field
156:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
157:     stars.forEach(s => {
158:       ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5;
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     });
163:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
164:     // Ship (triangle) with slight outline
165:     ctx.save();
166:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
167:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
168:     ctx.beginPath();
169:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
170:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
171:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
172:     ctx.closePath();
173:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ship.r, 0, ship.r);
174:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
175:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
176:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
177:     ctx.fill();
178:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
179:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
180:     ctx.stroke();
181:     ctx.restore();
182:     // Asteroids (rough circles with outline)
183:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
184:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#aaa';
185:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
186:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
187:       ctx.beginPath();
188:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
189:       ctx.fill();
190:       ctx.stroke();
191:     });
192:     // Fuel cells with glow
193:     fuels.forEach(f => {
194:       ctx.save();
195:       ctx.shadowColor = '#ff0';
196:       ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
197:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
198:       ctx.beginPath();
199:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
200:       ctx.fill();
201:       ctx.restore();
202:     });
203:     // Fuel bar
204:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
205:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, ship.fuel, 8);
206:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
207:     ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, 100, 8);
208:   }
209: 
210:   let last = performance.now();
211:   let running = true;
212:   function loop(ts) {
213:     if (!running) return;
214:     const dt = ts - last;
215:     last = ts;
216:     update(dt);
217:     draw();
218:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
219:   }
220: 
221:   function gameOver() {
222:     running = false;
223:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
224:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
225:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
226:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
227:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
228:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
229:   }
230: 
231:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
232: })();

(End of file - total 232 lines)
</content>
